description: This file defines the 'UserCreatedShelf' class, which extends a 'Shelf' class, representing a user-created bookshelf entity within a book-tracking application. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping, Lombok annotations for generating boilerplate code, and Jackson annotations for JSON serialization control.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelf
classes.description: An entity class representing a custom bookshelf created by a user, including fields for identification, name, associated user, and contained books. It also defines equality and hash code methods based on these fields.

methods.name: setShelfName
methods.description: Sets the shelf name, throwing an exception if the name is blank.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equality method to compare based on superclass fields, id, and books.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides to generate a hash based on superclass, id, and books.
